record.t: Sponsored a Colorado program in which cameras and an AI algorithm detect smoke plumes and alert first responders.
record.q: The goal with the Colorado program is for cameras and an AI algorithm to detect a plume of smoke and alert first responders who can stomp out the blaze before it grows, said Don Coram, a former Republican Colorado state senator who first backed the idea and encouraged this year's sponsor, Rep. Cleave Simpson, a Republican and rancher.
